'''Ghurn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and he worked as a high-ranking Republic official. When the Republic [[Agent/Legends|agents]] [[Klieri]] and [[Yrssk]] went missing while investigating the [[Deluge Experiment]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], Ghurn hired a group of individuals to investigate the agents' disappearance.
